# HH Goa 2026 · Frame & Builder ID Generator

> A free browser tool that turns one photo into a branded Hacker House Goa 2026
> graphic — a PFP frame, a Builder ID card, or a Squad card for up to three
> teammates. Built for Open Trials Task 01 of Hacker House Goa 2026.

Live site: https://hhgoa.trencoders.com/

## What it does

Upload a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC from an iPhone) and the tool draws a
finished graphic on an HTML5 canvas, then downloads it as a real PNG. Three
formats are available:

- **Builder ID card** — 1080 × 1350. Framed as a Goan port landing card: photo,
  name, stack/role, a rolled "callsign", the plan-build-deploy loop, what you are now
  building, a pass number with a deterministic barcode, and a scannable QR code
  back to the generator. Set against a drawn Arabian Sea sunset with an azulejo
  tile band.
- **PFP frame** — 1080 × 1080. A frame that wraps the photo for use as an X
  profile picture, designed so nothing important is lost to the circular crop.
- **Squad card** — 1600 × 900. One to three builders combined into one graphic.

## How it works

- Everything runs client-side. No account, no login, no signup, no upload.
- The photo never leaves the browser; there is no backend and no API key.
- Photos are cover-fitted automatically and EXIF orientation is respected, so
  portrait, landscape and off-centre photos work without pre-cropping. The photo
  can be dragged to reposition and zoomed with a slider.
- Output is produced with `canvas.toBlob` as a PNG.
- Share opens X with a caption pre-written, including the hashtag #FrameInGoa.

## Technology

Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with Canvas 2D. No framework, no build
step, no server. One vendored MIT dependency (qrcode-generator) for QR encoding,
and heic2any lazy-loaded from a CDN only when a HEIC file is actually selected.
Typography is Imbue, Victor Mono and Shrikhand, matching the official Hacker
House Goa 2026 identity.

## About the event

Hacker House Goa 2026 is a four-day builder residency in Goa, India, running
28–31 October 2026 for 247 in-person builders. Seats are earned by completing
skill-based Open Trials. Event site: https://hhgoa.com
